title.en: First exoplanet discovered around a Sun-like star
title.ru: Первая экзопланета у звезды, подобной Солнцу

summary.en: Michel Mayor and Didier Queloz announce 51 Pegasi b, the first planet found orbiting a Sun-like star, launching the modern search for exoplanets. They shared the 2019 Nobel Prize in Physics for the discovery.

sources.title: Mayor & Queloz, A Jupiter-mass companion to a solar-type star, Nature 378 (1995)
